generic_model.gain_computer: soft-knee Eq.4: y=x if 2(x-T)<-W; x+(1/R-1)(x-T+W/2)^2/(2W) if |2(x-T)|<=W; T+(x-T)/R above. Optional second segment: ratio2 above knee2_db over threshold.
generic_model.detector_default: log-domain, after gain computer (Eq.23), smooth decoupled peak (Eq.17); alpha=exp(-1/(tau*fs))

release_models.dual_stage: two branches on same target: fast(tauA,tauR_fast), slow(tau_charge,tauR_slow); combine max() or weighted w*fast+(1-w)*slow [S16]
release_models.constant_rate: release ramps at rate_db_per_s in dB (dbx) [S17,S18]
release_models.opto_memory: dual_stage weighted w=0.5 where tauR_slow = slow_min_s + M*(slow_max_s-slow_min_s); M charges from sustained GR with tau_mem_s
release_models.rc_network: simulate the unit's actual release RC network as coupled one-pole states in 'detector volts', then map volts->GR with the unit's gain-element law (Fairchild, SSL). Exact for linear networks; costs 2-3 multiplies per state per sample.
release_models.series_two_section: SSL Auto: two parallel-RC sections in series. Charging current i flows through both: dv1/dt=i/C1 - v1/(R1 C1); dv2/dt=i/C2 - v2/(R2 C2); control = v1+v2. Release = a1 e^-t/tau1 + a2 e^-t/tau2 exactly. UAD-confirmed 2026-10-19 (slow share within 0.02 of SPICE).
release_models.opto_light_memory: UAD-matched opto (Natural from 2026-10-19): release applied to LDR conductance u=10^(GR/20)-1 as two decays u(t)=u0*[(1-w_s)*exp(-t/tau_f)+w_s*exp(-t/tau_s)]; tau_f=0.032+0.045*M s, w_s=0.12+0.11*M, tau_s=0.90 s; M=1-exp(-d/0.3 s), d = time spent compressing (memory saturates after ~1 s)

generic_model.bloom_law: wet_gain_dB = clamp(Amount_dB + GR_dB, -MaxDuck_dB, +Amount_dB); applied to tail only; detector on dry (or dry+wet in self-keyed mode); per-sample detector; Amount=0 => bit-identical bypass

timing_definitions_rule.value: Fairchild and SSL panel release times ~= time to recover from ~10 dB GR to ~0.5-1 dB, i.e. ~2.1-2.5 x the RC time constant; not tau

bloom_presets.name: Natural
emulates: Teletronix LA-2A (behaviour of the UADx LA-2A Silver model)

sidechain_filter.note: LA-2A has optional HF-emphasis; off by default

ratio2.note: Comp mode never limits in UAD: local ratio peaks ~5.3 at ~13 dB GR and eases back to ~4 above ~20 dB GR; modelled as 4:1 from 20 dB above threshold (~16 dB GR). (UAD Limit mode: 3.8 -> 6.9 -> 13.6 -> inf at ~20 dB GR)

knee2_db_above_threshold.note: dB above threshold (input), ~16 dB GR at ratio 5

attack_ms.note: UAD Silver closed-loop t63 ~2 ms, t90 22-38 ms (Gray t63 2-3 ms, t90 14-34 ms). Faster than UA spec 10 ms [S7] and our cell SPICE (~20 ms)

release.form: conductance u=10^(GR/20)-1 decays as u0*[(1-w_s)e^(-t/tau_f)+w_s e^(-t/tau_s)]; M=1-exp(-d/tm), d = time compressing; memory drains with tm_decay when dark

tau_f_s.note: tuned so the two-decay law hits the measured conductance t63 0.044/0.090/0.112/0.113 s after 0.05/0.3/1/5 s (law gives 0.050/0.086/0.115/0.118 s). Free two-exponential fits on their own gave 0.052/0.076/0.085/0.086 s

tau_s_s.note: free fits 0.80-1.0 s; 0.90 s balances the 10 dB -> 1 dB time (law 1.27 s, UAD 1.13 s) and the 0.5 dB time (law 1.92 s, UAD 1.95 s)

tm_s.note: memory full after ~1 s of compression (was 2x0.84 s cascaded lags reaching full only after ~5 s)

tm_decay_s.note: UAD shows no long history; drain time not measured, set equal to tm

headline.value: conductance t63 ~0.11 s after any burst >= 1 s (0.044 s after 50 ms, 0.090 s after 0.3 s); from 10 dB: GR half-time ~0.1 s, within 1 dB ~1.1 s, within 0.5 dB ~2.0 s
